proof: If $\mathcal H$ contains a $d$-cube, restrict an interpolating polynomial to that cube.  Every real-valued function on the cube must then be representable; in particular its parity function requires degree $d$.  Hence $\mathrm{intdeg}(\mathcal H)\ge\mathrm{ST}(\mathcal H)$.
name: Interpolation degree / Largest Strongly Shattered Set
